journey.name: Use a conversation's menu and details at once on a tablet
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in on a tablet-sized screen (900 to 1199 CSS pixels wide), with at least one conversation in the list. On a tablet a conversation opens beside the list of conversations. Its three-dot menu and its details work from the moment the conversation is shown, not only a moment later.

actions.action: Tap the first conversation in the inbox list and, as soon as it opens, tap the three-dot button to the right of the message date
Verify that the conversation is shown beside the list of conversations, with a menu open listing "Reply", "Reply all", "Forward" and "Mark unread from here"
Press the Android Back button once
Verify that the inbox list is shown
Tap the first conversation in the inbox list and, as soon as it opens, tap the small down-arrow next to the recipients under the sender's name
Verify that the conversation is shown beside the list of conversations, with a panel showing "from:", "to:", "date:" and "subject:" details
